senses.gloss: m.(b. h.; זגג)pl. זַגִּים, זַגִּין (cmp. דכך) pomace of grapes, husks or kernels and flesh.
units: Naz. VI, 2 (34ᵇ) חרצנים … הז׳ אלו הפנימים ḥartsannim (Num. VI, 4) means the exterior, zaggim the interior; (ib. contrary opinion, v. זוֹג).—

<cite ref="Tosefta Tahorot 3:1">Tosef. Toh. III, 1</cite> <he>הגפן והזוּגִּין וכ׳</he> ed. Zuck. (oth. ed. <he>זַגִּין</he>; some ed. <he>זומין</he>, corr. acc.) the grape vine (clusters) and the pomace which have been treated in cleanness.
Sabb. IV, 1.—Naz. l. c. זַגָּן Mish. (Y. ed. זגין, Bab. ed. זג; Tosef. ib. IV, 2 זגא ed. Zuck., Var. זג) the husk (or the interior) of one berry.
